subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram group messages never dispatched despite confirmed Bot API delivery (DMs unaffected)

question: Which proof path should own the remaining Telegram group-ingress black-hole investigation before a repair is attempted?
rationale: The issue has credible operator evidence and current source supports the expected behavior, but the exact failing gate is not known and the issue is already marked for maintainer review/live repro instead of a new blind fix PR.

options.title: Require live Telegram proof first
options.body: Use a real Telegram group or Telegram proof lane to capture the delivered update, OpenClaw ingress/spool state, and whether a valid @mention reaches dispatch before assigning a repair.

options.title: Accept isolated replay proof
options.body: Use a recorded Bot API update payload and local isolated-ingress replay to find the drop point without a live Telegram roundtrip.

options.title: Pause pending new field evidence
options.body: Leave the issue open but do not schedule repair work until a reporter or maintainer can provide fresh current-main logs and payload context.

recommendation.title: Require live Telegram proof first
recommendation.body: Use a real Telegram group or Telegram proof lane to capture the delivered update, OpenClaw ingress/spool state, and whether a valid @mention reaches dispatch before assigning a repair.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest ownership trail for the current failure shape starts with the isolated polling ingress and spool worker path introduced in #81746.
